title: 宝塚記念の後に・なんとでっけえ雷鳴よ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One runs with everything she's got, managing to win the Takarazuka Kinen. Even Tamamo Cross congratulates her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After seeing how assured and focused Tamamo Cross already is on winning her next race, Inari One vows to win the Takarazuka Kinen again next year.
